Jordan: Heads-up — I opened PR #4567 to tidy up the cross-language examples for streaming + pagination. Main goals: unify retry/backoff guidance, add a tiny Go sample for cursor resume, and fix a couple broken links in docs. PTAL if you can today.

Elaine: link?

Jordan: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4567 — added TODOs in PR description for reviewers. The TS/py snippets pass lint locally but Go sample fails the go vet style on CI.

Mike: I'll take Go. What's the failure?

Jordan: CI log: `cmd/snippets/go/resume.go:12:6: exported type resumeCursor should have comment or be unexported` — trivial, just need a doc comment. Also the Go snippet uses a blocking Read() that can deadlock under streaming; added a note to use `context.WithTimeout`.

Sara: I can run the integration test against the hosted sample dataset. Also want to check pagination edge cases — zero-length page tokens and last-page semantics.

Mike: For backoff, let's standardize on exponential with jitter. Proposed snippet: `sleep = base * (2 ** attempt) * rand(0,1)` and cap at 5s. I'll paste a mini code for Go.

Mike: ```go
// backoffJitter sleeps with exponential backoff and jitter
func backoff(attempt int) time.Duration {
    base := 200 * time.Millisecond
    max := 5 * time.Second
    jitter := time.Duration(rand.Int63n(int64(base)))
    d := time.Duration(1<<uint(attempt)) * base
    if d > max { d = max }
    return d + jitter
}
```

Sara: Added a failing test to the PR for the pagination edgecase. CI run: `docs-integration/4567` failed on the TS snippet where we weren't awaiting the stream close. Fix: `await stream.close()`

Elaine: Quick doc-link fixes — two anchors changed after upstream rename. I pushed a small commit to the same PR.

Jordan: Awesome. Action items: Mike — update Go snippet with doc comment + backoff function. Sara — update TS sample to await stream close and add test. Elaine — verify links and commit message. I'll re-run the lint pipeline after you push. If green, merge and backfill CHANGES.md. :thumbsup:

doc-bot: Build queued by Jordan for PR #4567. Status: queued.

Mike: Pushed Go fix and comment. CI run started.

Jordan: Thanks. If anyone runs into flakiness, we should add a short section in the SDK snippets page about "stream lifecycle" and a minimal checklist: close streams, handle EOF, retry idempotently, cap backoff. I can draft that.

Elaine: can we also add a small table mapping py/ts/go snippets to canonical filenames? Makes linking easier.

Sara: Agree. I'll add to docs checklist.

Jordan: Cool — keeping this thread for final merge notes. Ping here when CI passes. If no objections, we'll merge by EOD.
